result.title: Direct Forcing: A Single-Stage Training Recipe for Few-Step Autoregressive Text-to-Video Generation
result.summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables low-latency streaming, yet prevailing training pipelines separate causal adaptation from distribution matching. Recent representation-based text-to-video methods retain this separation by starting from ODE-initialized checkpoints, even when the target distribution is defined directly by reference videos. We introduce Direct Forcing, a single-stage framework that uses reference videos both as paired examples of how a history continues and as a target population for self-generated rollouts. Causal Continuation Alignment learns paired spatiotemporal correspondence under reference histories, while Rollout Distribution Matching uses maximum mean discrepancy to align the representation distributions of self-generated and reference videos. Together, these complementary signals allow a pretrained video model to learn causal continuation and the target video distribution in a single training stage. Dynamic Gradient Balancing adapts the relative gradient contributions of continuation alignment and distribution matching during training. Starting from bidirectional Wan2.1-1.3B, Direct Forcing learns a four-step autoregressive generator in 250 updates without a separate initialization stage or online diffusion-score supervision, achieving 84.63 VBench Total and 86.01 Quality. Ablation studies further demonstrate the benefits of dynamic gradient balancing and reveal distinct representation preferences: deeper features benefit continuation alignment, whereas intermediate features yield better performance for rollout distribution matching.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Direct Forcing 单阶段训练框架，将参考视频同时作为因果续写的配对样例和自生成 rollout 的分布目标，结合续写对齐、基于 MMD 的 rollout 分布匹配与动态梯度平衡，把双向 Wan2.1-1.3B 训练为四步自回归视频生成器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用 MMD 对齐自生成 rollout 与参考序列的隐表示分布，且发现深层特征利于续写对齐、中间特征利于分布匹配，这一特征深度偏好可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的分布监督与表示层选择提供核查线索。
